messages.content: "你能告訴我著名足球運動員莱萊納爾·梅西的淨資產是多少歐元嗎？之後，我想知道籃球運動員勒布朗·詹姆斯的淨資產是多少英鎊。此外，我對一個使用公制系統的重85公斤、身高180公分的人的身體質量指數（BMI）也很好奇。最後，你能計算一個使用英制系統的重200磅、身高6英呎2英吋的人的BMI嗎？"

function.name: calculate_bmi
function.description: Calculate the Body Mass Index (BMI) of a person. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

weight.description: Weight of the person in kilograms.

height.description: Height of the person in centimeters.

unit.description: Optional parameter to choose between 'imperial' and 'metric' systems. Default is 'metric'.

function.name: celebrity_net_worth_get
function.description: Get the total net worth of a sports celebrity based on most recent data. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The full name of the sports celebrity.

currency.description: The currency in which the net worth will be returned. Default is 'USD'.

1. Net worth of Lionel Messi in euros.
2. Net worth of LeBron James in pounds sterling.
3. BMI of a person using metric system: weight 85 kg, height 180 cm.
4. BMI of a person using imperial system: weight 200 lbs, height 6 ft 2 in.

We need to produce separate calls for each request. The user wants all four. We can do multiple calls. According to guidelines, we should not combine calls into one. So we need to output separate calls. The order: first Messi net worth in euros, second LeBron net worth in pounds, third BMI metric, fourth BMI imperial.

We need to use the function calls. The function signature: celebrity_net_worth_get takes name and currency. For Messi: name "Lionel Messi", currency "EUR". For LeBron: name "LeBron James", currency "GBP".

For BMI: calculate_bmi takes weight, height, unit optional. For metric: weight 85, height 180, unit "metric". For imperial: weight 200, height 6 ft 2 in. But height is in centimeters? Wait, the function expects height in centimeters. But if unit is imperial, maybe height in inches? The function signature says height: number, but no unit. The optional unit param chooses between 'imperial' and 'metric'. So we can pass height in inches? But the user gave height 6 ft 2 in. We need to convert to inches: 6*12 + 2 = 74 inches. So weight 200 lbs, height 74 inches, unit "imperial".
